build_BCELoss: build a BCELoss module to compute binary cross entropy loss with optional target weights for classification
build_JSDiscretLoss: build a JSDiscretLoss module to compute Jensen-Shannon divergence loss for DSNT with Gaussian heatmaps
build_KLDiscretLoss: build a KLDiscretLoss module to compute KL divergence loss for SimCC with label smoothing
build_InfoNCELoss: build an InfoNCELoss module to compute contrastive InfoNCE loss for discriminative representation learning
review_classification_loss: review the classification loss classes BCELoss, JSDiscretLoss, KLDiscretLoss, and InfoNCELoss for pose estimation
